mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_analysis (user_id, analysis_id, conversation_content, status, error_message, processing_time_ms, educational_summary, llm_model_id, llm_model_name, llm_provider, point_dictionary_version, edit_annotations, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{analysisId}, #{conversationContent}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{processingTimeMs}, #{educationalSummary}, #{llmModelId}, #{llmModelName}, #{llmProvider}, #{pointDictionaryVersion}, #{editAnnotations}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, analysis_id, conversation_content, status, error_message, processing_time_ms, educational_summary, llm_model_id, llm_model_name, llm_provider, point_dictionary_version, edit_annotations, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_analysis WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}

SELECT id, user_id, analysis_id, conversation_content, status, error_message, processing_time_ms, educational_summary, llm_model_id, llm_model_name, llm_provider, point_dictionary_version, edit_annotations, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_analysis WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, analysis_id, conversation_content, status, error_message, processing_time_ms, educational_summary, llm_model_id, llm_model_name, llm_provider, point_dictionary_version, edit_annotations, created_at, updated_at FROM conversation_analysis WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
